description: Three roommates with different work schedules keep renegotiating quiet hours, cleaning duties, overnight guests, and shared expenses. They need a stable household system that everyone can actually remember and follow.

user_profile.persona: 28-year-old designer acting as the unofficial house coordinator
user_profile.context: Small annoyances are accumulating because old agreements were verbal and inconsistently remembered
user_profile.communication_style: Collaborative but tired of repeating the same conversations

fact_sheet.fact: The residents of apartment 4B at 123 Maple Lane are Liam Chen, Maya Singh, and Chloe Davis.
Liam Chen's mobile number for house-related emergencies is 555-0101.
Maya Singh works a night shift as a nurse from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM, Wednesday through Sunday.
Chloe Davis works an early morning shift as a baker from 4:00 AM to 12:00 PM, Tuesday through Saturday.
The total monthly rent for apartment 4B is $3,300, payable to 'Evergreen Properties'.
Rent is due on the 1st of each month via the Evergreen Properties online portal.
Liam Chen's share of the rent is $1,200 for the master bedroom with an en-suite bathroom.
Maya Singh's and Chloe Davis's share of the rent is $1,050 each for their respective standard bedrooms.
The 'Harmony Creek Power' electricity bill is under Chloe Davis's name and is split equally three ways.
The 'ConnectFast Fiber' internet bill is $75 per month and is under Liam Chen's name.
Maya and Chloe each Venmo Liam $25 for their share of the internet bill by the 5th of each month.
A shared fund for household supplies (e.g., paper towels, dish soap) is maintained via a $20 contribution from each roommate on the 1st of the month to a jar in the kitchen.
Any single shared supply purchase exceeding $30 requires group approval in the 'Apt-Expenses' Slack channel.
General quiet hours for the apartment are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM on weeknights (Sunday-Thursday).
Weekend quiet hours (Friday-Saturday) are from 12:00 AM (midnight) to 9:00 AM.
Special 'Daytime Quiet Hours' are in effect from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays to accommodate Maya Singh's sleep schedule.
Use of loud appliances like the vacuum cleaner or blender is restricted to between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM daily.
The kitchen cleaning duty rotates weekly every Sunday at 6:00 PM, with the schedule posted on the refrigerator.
The person on kitchen duty is responsible for wiping all counters, cleaning the stovetop, and mopping the floor.
The shared bathroom is deep-cleaned every Saturday; Chloe and Maya alternate weeks.
Trash and recycling must be taken to the building's disposal area when the bins are more than 75% full.
A 24-hour notice must be given in the '#guests' Slack channel for any overnight guests.
An individual roommate may not have an overnight guest for more than three consecutive nights.
The total number of nights any single guest can stay in the apartment per calendar month is seven.
No more than one roommate may host an overnight guest on the same night without unanimous agreement from all three roommates.
A maximum of four total guests (including roommates' guests) are allowed in the apartment at any one time, unless for a pre-approved event.
Dishes must be washed or placed in the dishwasher immediately after use; the dishwasher should be run when full.
The living room television volume must be kept below level 25 during Daytime Quiet Hours (9 AM - 4 PM weekdays).
Personal items left in common areas (living room, kitchen) for more than 48 hours will be moved to the 'Lost & Found' basket.
The thermostat is to be set no lower than 72°F in the summer and no higher than 68°F in the winter.
All official household rules are documented in a shared Google Doc titled 'Apt 4B Household Accord'.
The 'Apt 4B Household Accord' was last updated on July 15, 2024, by Liam Chen.
A mandatory 'State of the Apartment' meeting is scheduled for the first Sunday of each month at 7:00 PM.
Any proposed changes to the agreement require a 2/3 majority vote during the monthly meeting to be adopted.
